verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a local API that runs on localhost inside the desktop app. It has a published OpenAPI spec and documented operations to query, retrieve and update objects, plus a CLI headless server for automation and scripting, so the local-endpoint path for creating and editing notes from scripts is covered. Nothing in the evidence shows a URI scheme, deep links, or any way to open a note in the app UI from outside, and there is no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: URI scheme / deep-link support, documented ability to open a specific note in the desktop UI externally, independent or hands-on corroboration of scripted workflows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the app from outside — create or open notes via a URI scheme, deep links, or a local endpoint — to wire it into my scripts and workflows

citations.quote: Our API is now available and directly included with the desktop app, running entirely on localhost.
